rows.limitation: KEPT PARTIAL BY DESIGN (no promotion). Null model (N=3000, seed 20260623) scores mean ~0.731 vs configured ~0.999 at T=0.95 (~2.7σ) — this is a statistical SEPARATION (admissibility evidence), NOT a falsifiable per-input hard contract, so it does not warrant an operational INV. DA/5HT and E/I are uncited engineering ratios with no physiological clamp (QUARANTINE_DOC: relabel as arithmetic ratios, do not promote). Promotion is DECLINED on epistemic grounds (no honest hard invariant exists), not merely pending an INV name.

That UNBOUNDEDNESS is now an executable negative witness (tests/unit/neuro/test_hebbian_global_stability.py: sustained LTP grows ~lr_floor/step without ceiling, monotone in horizon). Promotion is declined on epistemic grounds (no global bound exists), NOT merely pending an INV name.

rows.limitation: PROMOTED PARTIAL→OPERATIONAL. INV-HOM1 (conditional): the common-mode reset wave is Lyapunov-energy non-increasing (E_post ≤ E_pre, E=gain·mean(1−cosΔφ)); contract violations raise; over-threshold |Δφ| fail-closes to safety_lock. Bound to INV-HOM1 in CLAUDE.md + INVARIANTS.yaml. SCOPE/NON-CLAIM (kept explicit): ENGINEERING analogue, not neuroscience — energy descent is proven ONLY for coherent common-mode phase error; for heterogeneous error the scalar-mean correction is not a guaranteed descent direction. E/I, 'serotonin', 'GABA tone' are arithmetic proxies.
